devdoc.author: Your Name/Organization (or remove if desired)
devdoc.details: This contract demonstrates borrowing USDC on Aave (Sepolia), swapping it for WETH on Uniswap V2 (Sepolia),      swapping the WETH back to USDC on SushiSwap V2 (Sepolia), and repaying the loan.      It includes basic slippage protection but is intended for educational purposes.      Does NOT account for gas costs in profitability checks.

params._poolAddressesProvider: The address of the Aave V3 IPoolAddressesProvider contract (for Sepolia).
params._sushiRouterAddress: The address of the SushiSwap V2 Router contract (for Sepolia).
params._uniswapRouterAddress: The address of the Uniswap V2 Router contract (for Sepolia).
params._usdcAddress: The address of the USDC token contract (for Sepolia).
params._wethAddress: The address of the WETH token contract (for Sepolia).

executeOperation(address,uint256,uint256.details: Executes the predefined arbitrage strategy (USDC -> WETH -> USDC) and handles repayment.      Reverts if the strategy fails or if repayment conditions are not met.

params._initiator: The address that initiated the flash loan request (unused in this implementation).
params._params: Arbitrary data passed during the `flashLoanSimple` call (unused in this implementation).
params.amount: The amount of the token borrowed.
params.asset: The address of the borrowed token (must be USDC for this contract).
params.premium: The fee charged by Aave for the flash loan.

returns._0: bool Returns `true` if the operation and repayment approval were successful.

requestFlashLoan(uint256).details: Triggers the flash loan process; `executeOperation` will be called by Aave.

params._amount: The amount of USDC to borrow.

withdrawEther().details: Reverts if called by non-owner or if the transfer fails.

withdrawToken(address).details: Can only be called by the owner. Only allows withdrawing the configured USDC or WETH.

params._tokenAddress: The address of the ERC20 token to withdraw.
